newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia 91-day T-bill issue volume raised.
newsitem.headline: Croatia 91-day T-bill issue volume raised.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry sold 60 million kuna in 91-day treasury bills at auction on Tuesday.
It had offered 40 million kuna worth of bills but received bids for 71 million. The weighted average price was 97.106 at the rate of 11.95 percent.

Bid rates ranged between 5.54 and 13 percent and prices between 96.861 and 98.638. Over 76 percent of buyers came from the banking sector, the ministry said in a press release faxed to news agency Hina.
The issued rate eased 50 basis points to 12.50 percent from a month ago, with the price rising to 96.978 from 96.861.
The government set the next auction for February 11, when it will seek to raise 50 million kuna through 91-day T-bills. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
